content.short: Summon heroes, build a guild and clear roguelite dungeons in Guild of Guardians, a mobile RPG on Immutable.
content.description: Guild of Guardians is set in the world of Elderym and plays like a classic mobile squad RPG. You summon Guardians, level them up, choose a team and run roguelite dungeons, alone or with friends in a guild. Heroes and gear are onchain assets, so players can trade them. The game is published by Immutable, developed by Mineloader and available on iOS and Android. The game runs seasonal events and limited summons, and its Dungeons mode and tournament tools give guilds new ways to compete.
content.meta: Mobile squad RPG on Immutable with collectible heroes, guilds and roguelite dungeon runs. Explore Guild of Guardians on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
